title: Tailwind CSS Review Quiz
description: Review the small examples from this Tailwind CSS course. Take your time and read the reason given for each answer.

questions.question: What does font-bold change?
questions.explanation: A utility class has one small style job. In Tailwind, you combine these small choices directly on an HTML element.

questions.question: Which class adds space inside the box?
questions.explanation: Padding is space inside a box. Margin is space outside a box. Tailwind uses short names for both.

questions.question: What does leading-7 control?
options: The height of each text line
questions.explanation: Text size and line spacing work together. A paragraph is easier to read when the lines are not squeezed together.

questions.question: Which class gives the box round corners?
questions.explanation: A background fills a box, while a border marks its edge. Text needs enough contrast against its background.

questions.question: Which class adds space between these flex items?
questions.explanation: Flex layout places child boxes in a row by default. You can centre them vertically and give them a gap.

questions.question: How many columns does grid-cols-2 create?
options: Two rows and any number of columns
questions.explanation: A grid can arrange boxes in rows and columns. The number in grid-cols tells Tailwind how many equal columns to create.

questions.question: Which layout is used below md?
questions.explanation: A responsive prefix applies a class from a chosen screen width upwards. Unprefixed classes are the starting rules for all widths.

questions.question: Why add focus-visible classes?
options: To hide the button from keyboards
To show which control the keyboard is using
questions.explanation: A state prefix changes a style when an element is in that state. focus-visible is useful for a clear keyboard focus mark.

questions.question: Why are both background and text classes changed?
options: To keep the words readable in both themes
Because dark mode removes all text
questions.explanation: The dark variant supplies styles for a dark colour setting. Tailwind 4 uses the system colour preference by default.

questions.question: Which utility can use --color-leaf?
questions.explanation: A theme variable adds a design choice that Tailwind can turn into utilities. The --color prefix creates colour utilities.

questions.question: Which approach lets Tailwind see each full class?
options: A map of complete class strings
Joining unknown colour pieces only at runtime
questions.explanation: Tailwind finds class names by reading your source files as text. Complete class names let it discover the styles you need.

questions.question: What does max-w-sm limit?
options: The maximum width of the card
questions.explanation: A small card combines several single-job classes. Each class still has one job: space, border, text size or layout.
